How it works

From referral to commission, in three quiet moves.

One

You refer

Recommend Temptation Jewellery to your couple and share your unique partner code — it takes one line in your vendor list.

Two

They visit

Your couple books a fitting in-store or browses online. Their visit is tracked automatically against your code.

Three

You earn

Once the order is placed, your commission is calculated and paid out — no invoicing, no chasing.
